description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView used to output log data received through the LogNode interface. It formats log messages for display, handling different log levels, exceptions, and chaining log nodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays log messages received via the LogNode interface.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and displays a log message, converting priority levels to strings, handling exceptions, and updating the UI thread.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView.
